title: The Toll at the Bridge
text: The Tollmaster's reeve stops the party at the bridge in {node} and asks for the toll: four loaves, or a book.

choices.label: Pay the toll in bread
choices.chronicle: {When}, the party paid the Tollmaster's toll at {node} and were let over the bridge.

choices.label: Offer a book instead
choices.chronicle: {When}, the party paid the toll at {node} in a book, and the reeve wrote its title in his ledger.

choices.label: Refuse and go round by the ford

yes.chronicle: The Tollmaster's riders caught the party at the ford below {node}, and {monk} was struck on the shoulder.

no.chronicle: The party reached the far bank of the Shannon dry and unseen.

title: A Cooper's Offer
text: A cooper in the market at {node} offers a barrel of salt fish for two of the house's books. He says books are worth more in a town than in a ruin.

choices.label: Trade two books for the fish
choices.chronicle: {When}, the party traded two books at {node} for a barrel of salt fish.

yes.chronicle: {When}, the cooper at {node} gave the party a sack of oats for their trouble.

title: The Office Shelves
text: In a half-collapsed office the party finds steel shelves still holding grey boxes of paper. The paper is damp, and nobody in the district can read it.

choices.label: Carry back what can be saved
choices.chronicle: {When}, the party carried two books back from the ruins at {node}, the best of what was there.

title: A Coil of Copper
text: A turbine on the bog at {node} still turns in the wind. A turf-cutter offers the copper coil from its base for food.

choices.label: Buy the coil
choices.chronicle: {When}, the party bought a coil of copper from the bog folk at {node}.

title: The Lord's Dead Son
text: The lord of {node} will hear the party if they bring a gift. He keeps his own chaplain and asks the house to pray for his dead son.

effects.chronicle: {When}, {monk} prayed for the dead son of the lord of {node}, and the lord sent the party home with a sack of oats.

yes.chronicle: {When}, the lord of {node} gave the party alms from his store.

no.chronicle: The lord's steward sent the party away with nothing.

title: The Steward's Figures
text: The steward at {node} asks whether any brother can read figures. He offers food for a fortnight of accounts.

effects.chronicle: {When}, {monk} checked the accounts of the lord of {node} for a fortnight and was paid in oats.

choices.label: The house has no time for ledgers

title: The Names at the Well
text: The keeper of the well at {node} asks the party to pray for the dead of the last famine. He has a long list of names written on a board.

choices.label: Say the names until the candle is out

effects.chronicle: {When}, {monk} said the names of the famine dead at {node} until the candle burned out.

title: A Child at the Well
text: A child with a fever is carried to the well at {node}. Her mother asks the brothers to bless the water.

choices.label: Bless the water and give the last fever-draught

yes.chronicle: {When}, {monk} blessed the water at {node}, and the child's fever broke by morning. Her mother walked them to the road.

no.chronicle: {When}, the child at {node} died in the night, and her mother blessed the brothers anyway.

effects.chronicle: {When}, {monk} blessed the water at {node} for a child with a fever.

title: The Old Psalm-Tunes
text: A hermit on the lake offers to teach the party the old psalm-tunes his grandmother sang, if they will sing them with him.

effects.chronicle: {When}, {monk} sang the old psalm-tunes with the hermit of {node} until dark, and came home with them in his head.

title: The Hermit Who Did Not Come
text: The hermit of {node} has not been seen for three weeks. His hut is cold, and a boat is pulled up on the shore, half full of water.

yes.chronicle: {When}, {monk} found the hermit of {node} alive in a cave and fed him from the party's bread.

no.chronicle: {When}, {monk} did not come back from the island at {node}. The boatmen said the lake took him in the night, looking for the hermit.

choices.label: Leave the shore as it is

title: Barley and Too Few Hands
text: The glen folk of {node} have the barley in and too few hands to thresh it. They offer grain for labour.

effects.chronicle: {When}, the party threshed barley at {node} for a week and were paid in grain.

title: A Feud in the Glen
text: A feud in {node} has two families at each other's throats. The headman asks the party to stand between them.

yes.chronicle: {When}, {monk} stood between two families at {node}, and they laid down their sticks.

no.chronicle: {When}, {monk} was struck at {node} trying to stop a feud, and the families fought on.

title: Smoked Fish for a Sick Child
text: Boatmen at {node} sell smoked fish. They want medicine for a sick daughter in exchange.

choices.label: Trade medicine for a crate of fish

effects.chronicle: {When}, the party traded medicine at {node} for a crate of smoked fish.
{When}, the party traded grain at {node} for smoked fish.

title: Cargo from the Strand
text: A boat has come ashore below {node} with its crew drowned. Its cargo of wool is still dry in the hold.

choices.label: Carry the cargo up the cliff

effects.chronicle: {When}, the party carried a wreck's cargo up from the strand at {node} and buried the crew.

choices.label: Leave the dead to the sea

title: The Battery in the Tower
text: The old signal tower above {node} still has a battery that gives a little light when touched. A boy from the coast says the old men once spoke to ships with it.

effects.chronicle: {When}, the party carried a battery down from the signal tower at {node}. The scribes think it may still hold a little of the old light.

title: The Tollmaster's Search
text: The Tollmaster's men search the party in {node} for old-world goods. One of them recognises the brothers' books.

effects.chronicle: {When}, the Tollmaster's men at {node} took a book from the party and wrote its title in their ledger.

choices.label: Hide the books in the cart

yes.chronicle: The Tollmaster's men went through the cart at {node} and found nothing.

no.chronicle: {When}, the Tollmaster's men at {node} took two books and a sack of grain from the party for hiding them.

title: Bells Under the Sea
text: At low water the party hears the bells of the drowned church at Inishkeel, faint under the waves.

effects.chronicle: {When}, {monk} heard the bells of Inishkeel ring under the sea at low water, and the brothers wrote down the hour.

title: The Turbine in the Gale
text: In a gale a turbine on the Bog of Allen begins to turn, slowly and then fast, and the bog folk fall silent to watch it.

effects.chronicle: {When}, the party watched a turbine turn on the Bog of Allen in a gale, and the bog folk stood silent for an hour.

title: No Boat on the Lake
text: The boat that should take the party to the hermit's island is gone. A child says a man took it across the lake last winter and did not come back.

yes.chronicle: {When}, {monk} waded the shallows of Lough Dearg with the party and reached the hermit's island with wet feet.

no.chronicle: {When}, {monk} went into the cold water at Lough Dearg and came out shaking with a fever.

yes.chronicle: {monk} came home from the road with news of the country and a list of who had died.

no.chronicle: {monk} came home from the road and would say little of what he had seen.

effects.chronicle: {monk} came home from the road with a wound that would not close quickly.
{monk} came home from the road and went straight to the chapel.
